name: @cms/storage
description: Governance-data persistence contract and Drizzle/Postgres implementation for the handoff CMS. Stores tenants, actors, region bindings, proposals, approvals, revisions, publications, deploy receipts, audit events, and idempotency records. Content/assets remain host-owned; this package only persists governed deltas, references, and diffs. Consumers must import the built `dist/` artifact.
